author: Skquid
body:
Map Author: {tag=c1d94f186ea3495a8d1b7d9eaf393f64} 
Contributors: {tag=2df2bef66f504e4ea891048990bf1f5c} , {tag=9ec823384c1d4b3897b2fedd0a92923c}
Images: https://imgur.com/a/u2KYr
XML/Download: WIP

So yeah, I know that Avicus is closing, but hey, I have to at least submit one map before it ends. Anyways, I started making this on New Year's eve, and finished today.

It's a DTM map based off of Japan, and more specifically the eastern former capital of Kyoto. This is kind of based off of a famous battle between a small Japanese clan, the Oda Clan, and their battle to take the capital from the Imagawa Clan. But hey, who cares about history.

Team colors are Yellow (Oda Clan) and Black (Imagawa Clan)
This is the first map that I am the main author of, so of course feedback is appreciated. I tried my hand at a unique map, hopefully it plays well.

Edit: Oh yeah there's a poll in the image album so make sure to take it

replies.author: Skquid
replies.body:
Update: I changed the black team to the white team, as black is very hard to see in chat and on the scoreboard
I have also changed the white team's banner to add a white border, and to make it easier to distinguish which team is which color.
I have also added bedrock inside of the middle island, added more iron blocks, and fixed a few detail mistakes, as well as changed the style of a bridge to keep a continuity.
